title: NameGraph
description: The package name-graph as `notlob graph` prints it: one tree of nodes for each .lob file, joined by CONTAINS edges, with the cross-reference edges between them. `level` says how much is shown: `outline` has every node but the anonymous leaves (PROSE, CODE, BULLETS), with their edges moved to the section that holds them; `index` has every node, `refs` on a PROSE leaf and a `size` on every node; `full` adds `text` on each node that holds text, once.

version.description: The version of this document format.

level.description: How much of the graph is shown, and so which optional node fields to expect: `size` and `refs` from `index` on, `text` at `full`.

nodes.description: The nodes of the graph, in the order they were added.

edges.description: The directed edges of the graph.

GraphNode.description: One element of a .lob file: a module, a section, a paragraph, a code block, a claim, a test, a symbol, or an external file.

label.description: Human-readable name as written in source.

kind.description: What kind of element this node is.

named.description: True where the document gives the node a name (a heading, a `##group`, a `~property` or a `~test`); its `label` is the name. Absent for an anonymous node and for what a document does not name.

mode.description: When a RUN runs; present on a RUN only. A bare `~run` is `on-invocation`.

declares.description: What a DECLARATION declares; present on a DECLARATION only.

value.description: The value a DECLARATION gives it (the language, or the file), when it has one; present on a DECLARATION only.

file.description: The .lob file it is written in, relative to the project root, with '/' separators. Absent for an external file and for a module built on its own.

start_line.description: 1-based line of its file where it begins.

end_line.description: 1-based last non-blank line of its file that it occupies.

size.description: The characters of text held at or under the node, each leaf's text counted once; a symbol holds none of its own, so it adds nothing to its section and its own size is that of its lines. Present from `index` on.

refs.description: The references a paragraph holds, in the order written. Present on a PROSE node from `index` on.

text.description: The text the node holds: a paragraph with its references written with their sigils, a dedented code block, a bullet list's items one to a line, a claim's dedented lines, a run of assertions or a named test as written. Present at `full` on each node that holds text, and never on a symbol (its lines are in its code block).

GraphRef.description: A `#Label` or `##Label` written in a paragraph.

label.description: What it names, without the sigil.

sub.description: True for `##Label`, which names a subheading of the module only.

GraphEdge.description: A directed relationship between two nodes.

kind.description: CONTAINS: a node to what is written in it (the trees); CITES: a paragraph to the node a `#Label` in it names; USES: code to a symbol it refers to by name; IMPORTS: a module to a module it lists in #References; USES_EXTERNAL: the binding module to a file it declares.

start_line.description: 1-based line of the source's file of the first reference or call site, where the edge has one. Where edges are merged, the earliest.
